- **Depends on:** none (206 depends on this card, 207 on 206). This card lands first.
- **Actor:** the mob-defaults facilitator in card mode (a system actor: run_card_mode in facilitator.py, with corrective_gate_message and read_card_issue)
- **Given:** a card about to start, a findings file that may hold blocking findings (read fields: id, status), and the card's GitHub issue read through gh
- **Observes:** exit 0 and nothing printed by the gate when the card may start; exit 5 and a message naming the blocking findings (or the reason the issue could not be checked) when it may not
- **Fails with:** exit 5 when a blocking finding exists and the issue names none of them by the exact token F-NNN (a near-miss such as F-0080 or f-008, a closed finding, or one token out of several blocking ones that the issue does not name do not count); exit 5, failing closed, when the card has no issue number or the issue cannot be read (gh fails, is missing, times out, or returns an empty body)
- **Invariants:** with no blocking finding, or no findings file, any card starts as before; the gate reads only id and status and the issue body, never the product repository; commit rules, lanes, probes and staffing are unchanged
- **Enables:** 206 (Steve as the product owner who reads the audit: the corrective card that adds the findings file is startable while F-001 and F-008 block) and 207; no non-corrective work can start during a stop-the-line
- **One observable behaviour:** While a finding blocks, the facilitator in card mode starts a card only if its issue names a blocking finding as its corrective action, and otherwise refuses with exit 5.
- **Done checks (at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Corrective start: with a blocking finding and an issue that names one by the exact token F-NNN the card starts (exit 0); with no blocking finding or no findings file any card starts as before. ZOMBIES: Z (no findings file, no blocking finding), O (one blocking finding named), M (several blocking, the issue names one), I (exit 0 and nothing printed). N/A: B and E, covered by checks 2 and 3
  2. Refusal: with a blocking finding and an issue that names none (no token, F-0080, f-008, only a closed finding, or one token out of several blocking ones not named), card mode returns exit 5 and prints a message naming the blocking findings. ZOMBIES: O, M, B (F-0080, f-008, a closed finding named, the token inside a longer word), I (exit 5 and the message). N/A: Z (check 1), E (check 3)
  3. Fail closed: with a blocking finding and a card with no issue number or an unreadable issue (gh fails, is missing, times out, or returns an empty body), card mode returns exit 5 and the message says why the issue could not be checked. ZOMBIES: Z (no issue number, empty body), E (gh fails, missing, timeout), B (unreadable body text), I (exit 5 and the printed reason). N/A: M and O, covered by checks 1 and 2

## Context

- One concern: the stop-the-line door in the mob-defaults facilitator. It is the first part of the first corrective card under D145 C7, so it must land before anything else can start while F-001 and F-008 block. Recorded in mob-defaults with a reference to D145, red test first.
- Layers, outside in (named by the architect): run_card_mode in facilitator.py returns exit 5; a pure corrective_gate_message(findings, issue_body) in mob_process.py decides and words the refusal; read_card_issue(card, runner) reads the issue body through gh with an injected runner, so tests never call gh.
- Files (estimate): facilitator.py, mob_process.py, and their tests (tests/test_card_mode.py and the mob_process tests), all in mob-defaults; one commit, below the D136 limits.
- Deliberately left to the others: 206 (the .mob/findings.json register mirror, its schema check, the F-008 explicit corrective_paths, the .gitignore negation) and 207 (history, ancestry and auditor rules, docs/AUDIT-CHECKLIST.md). This card does not read or write the product repository, does not define the findings file schema beyond the fields the gate reads (id, status), and does not change commit rules, lanes, probes or staffing.
- Follow docs/CODING_GUIDELINES.md where mob-defaults has an equivalent. Red first (D137): one acceptance test per criterion, Status=Pending with Criterion=NNN-K until its last unit lands.
